title: Audit retention window (metadata-only fields) is delegated to the applied logging companion
context: The validator emits one audit event per outcome with the metadata-only shape {email, outcome, timestamp, path}. Long-term retention is a compliance decision an applied logging companion already answers.
decision: Retention is delegated to the applied logging companion (suggestedCompanions[0]). The blueprint declares no retention policy of its own. Standards trace clause: generic enterprise practice.
consequences: A workspace without a logging companion loses the audit events after the Worker context tears down; the guide names the trade.
